svg.aria-label: Three curves stacked from top to bottom, the density of X_t at t = 0, 5 and 10 for random-walk Metropolis started from N(5, 1), each over the gray outline of the N(0, 1) target. The curve moves toward the target and widens, then narrows. An arrow from 0 to the mean of X_t reads 5.00 at t = 0, 1.40 at t = 5, 0.27 at t = 10: smaller at each time, and not zero.
